attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "Changes behavior of Liquid access to QueryString/Headers/Form values from array-of-strings to StringValuesValue, which alters equality, string concatenation, and indexing semantics (e.g. multi-value string comparison now concatenates instead of matching an array), potentially breaking existing templates that rely on prior array/string coercion behavior."}

reason: Changes behavior of Liquid access to QueryString/Headers/Form values from array-of-strings to StringValuesValue, which alters equality, string concatenation, and indexing semantics (e.g. multi-value string comparison now concatenates instead of matching an array), potentially breaking existing templates that rely on prior array/string coercion behavior.
